description: This class includes mining and quarrying of various minerals and materials not elsewhere classified.
includes: mining of abrasive materials, asbestos, silica sands, kernite, mica, steatite (talc), feldspar etc.
mining of natural asphalt, asphaltites and rock asphalts; natural solid bitumen
mining of gem stones (precious and semi-precious stones): diamonds, emeralds, rubies, sapphires, amber, etc.
mining of pumice stone and emery
excludes: mining of chemical and fertilizer minerals, see 0891
